logo.clear_space: At least 16px around the logo lockup
logo.restrictions: Never recolor, stretch, regenerate lettering, or overlay with competing text

gold_dark.usage: Accent shadows/borders, not small body text

green.usage: Illustrated trees or sparing success accent

typography.web_heading: Inter or system sans, 36-56px H1 responsive, extra-bold
typography.display_graphics: Press Start 2P, only where licensed and only in small decorative/static graphics

imagery.rendering: Preserve alpha and aspect ratio; nearest-neighbor when enlarging true pixel art
imagery.alt_text: Concise, functional, and never a duplicate of nearby text

editorial.primary_headline: Your Philly property. Your next move.
editorial.trust: Support all assertions; never invent metrics, credentials or reviews

compliance.consent: Marketing opt-in distinct, optional and unchecked by default
compliance.trademarks: Avoid protected municipal, transit, stadium, team and landmark logos without permission
compliance.images: Property illustrations are not photographs or proof of actual listings
